$comment: Single source of truth for every tunable number. Rule 1: never inline these in code.

merge.$note: Two units become one, so a multiplier below 2.0 removes the incentive to merge.

units.$note: damagePerShot = dps * attackInterval; maxHp = dps * hpPerDps; a merged unit spawns at full HP.

energy.$note: summonCost = summonBaseCost + summonCostStep * summonsThisWave; the counter resets each wave.
energy.$tutorialStart: First-ever run, stage 1 only, while the merge tutorial is showing. Two summons cost 3 + 4 = 7, so this cannot be the reason a new player fails to reach their first merge inside 20s. Not modelled by the simulator: it applies to one wave of one run.

run.$maxLives: startLives 3 + startLife perma upgrade at max level 3. Below this the third level of that upgrade would buy nothing.

shielded.$note: Projectiles from units of tier <= 3 deal 0 damage.

flyer.$note: Walks through occupied cells without stopping, but can still be shot.

bomb.$note: Defused by consuming the bombed cell's unit in a merge; otherwise destroys that cell plus its 4 orthogonal neighbours.

meta.$note: Permanent upgrades bought with accumulated gold. 3 levels each.
meta.$costs: Phase 7 brief: 100 / 250 / 600 for every permanent upgrade, so the shop is one ladder the player learns once.
